passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: Amy is my classmate, and she is a kind girl.
phrases.ko: 에이미는 나의 반 친구이고, 친절한 여자아이예요.

phrases.en: I sit next to her in class.
phrases.ko: 나는 수업 시간에 에이미 옆에 앉아요.

phrases.en: She is quiet, but she smiles at me.
She can lend a pencil when I forget mine.
phrases.ko: 내가 연필을 잊어버리면 에이미가 빌려 줄 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I like my classmate because she is fair.
phrases.ko: 에이미는 공정해서 나는 반 친구를 좋아해요.

phrases.en: We are both in the sixth grade.
She sits next to the window.
A quiet classmate can still be a good friend.
phrases.ko: 조용한 반 친구도 좋은 친구가 될 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I am happy she can lend me a pencil.
phrases.ko: 연필을 빌려 줄 수 있어서 기뻐요.

full_passage_spoken: Amy is my classmate, and she is a kind girl. I sit next to her in class. She is quiet, but she smiles at me. She can lend a pencil when I forget mine. We study together after lunch. I like my classmate because she is fair. We are both in the sixth grade. She sits next to the window. A quiet classmate can still be a good friend. We study English together. I am happy she can lend me a pencil.
